newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB sees 800 mln pesos from sale of unit.
newsitem.headline: PNB sees 800 mln pesos from sale of unit.

text.p: The Philippine National Bank (PNB) is expecting to receive at least 800 million pesos from the sale of its subsidiary PNB-Republic Bank, bank president Peter Favila said on Tuesday.
PNB is selling 60 percent of the small commercial bank through bidding.

Favila said eight groups have expressed interest to participate in the bidding. These include the Malayan Banking Bhd, Equitable Banking Corp, National Australian Bank and a group headed former banker Francisco Dizon.
The deadline for the submission of bids has been set on December 18.
Earlier, PNB was contemplating selling 100 percent of the bank, but decided to keep a strategic stake in the bank.

"I felt there was intangible assets which ought to be given some valuation, such as manpower and the organisation itself," Favila told reporters at the bank's special stockholders meeting. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
